title: MegaloEvolved Alpha
message: Welcome to the MegaloEvolved Alpha. In this version you can create gametypes for Halo: Reach MCC or Xbox 360. For example scripts, check out the Halo: Reach Editing Kit.|n|nIf you're new to Megalo, check out the [documentation](docs).|n|nPlease report any bugs or suggestions to codie on Discord or via [GitHub](https://github.com/craftycodie/MegaCrow).
